mapper.select: SELECT ti.id as track_id,ti.track_title,ti.media_duration,ti.order_num, MAX(if (stat_type ='0401',stat_num,0)) playStatNum, MAX(if (stat_type ='0404',stat_num,0)) ommentStatNum from track_info ti INNER JOIN track_stat ts on ti.id=ts.track_id and ts.is_deleted=0 where ti.album_id=#{albumId} and ti.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY ti.id ORDER BY ti.order_num
